# Zivel

> Zivel is a science-backed wellness studio brand offering recovery, performance, and aesthetics services. Studios are located across the United States and focus on evidence-informed modalities including cryotherapy, red light therapy, infrared sauna, and compression therapy.

## About Zivel

Zivel operates wellness studios designed around the principle that recovery is the foundation of performance, longevity, and appearance. Every service offered is selected based on peer-reviewed research and clinical evidence. Studios are designed to be accessible, premium, and results-oriented — serving athletes, professionals, and wellness-focused individuals.

Tagline: Recover Smarter. Look Better. Feel Stronger.

Website: https://www.zivel.com

## Services

Zivel offers eight core service modalities:

- **Cryotherapy** — Whole-body and localized cold exposure for recovery, inflammation reduction, and energy. Sessions are 2–3 minutes in a cryo chamber at ultra-low temperatures. URL: /services/cryotherapy
- **Red Light Therapy** — Near-infrared and red wavelength light panels targeting cellular energy production, skin health, and muscle recovery. URL: /services/red-light-therapy
- **Infrared Sauna** — Full-spectrum infrared heat for detoxification, cardiovascular support, and deep relaxation. URL: /services/infrared-sauna
- **Dry Float** — Zero-gravity pod sessions using Epsom salt solution for decompression, stress relief, and nervous system reset. URL: /services/dry-float
- **Cryo Slimming** — Non-invasive body contouring using controlled cold to target and reduce localized fat cells. URL: /services/cryo-slimming
- **Cryo Toning** — Thermal contrast technique alternating cold and mild warmth to firm and tone skin on targeted areas. URL: /services/cryo-toning
- **CryoLift Facial** — Cryo-based facial treatment that reduces puffiness, tightens skin, and improves complexion. URL: /services/cryo-lift-facial
- **Compression Therapy** — Pneumatic compression sleeves promoting lymphatic drainage, circulation, and recovery. URL: /services/compression-therapy

## Wellness Pathways

Zivel organizes services into goal-based Pathways — curated multi-service programs aligned to specific outcomes:

- **Recovery** — Reduce soreness, support healing, and return to peak performance faster
- **Performance** — Optimize energy, endurance, and physical output
- **Beauty** — Improve skin quality, tone, and facial appearance
- **Longevity** — Support cellular health, inflammation control, and long-term vitality

Pathway details: https://www.zivel.com/pathways
